live.canon|genesis|21:10: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|21:11: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
live.canon|genesis|21:14: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
live.canon|genesis|21:15: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
live.canon|genesis|21:16: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
live.canon|genesis|21:19: And Elohim (God) opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
live.canon|genesis|21:20: And Elohim (God) was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
live.canon|genesis|21:21: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|21:24: And Abraham said, I will swear.
live.canon|genesis|21:25: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
live.canon|genesis|21:27: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
live.canon|genesis|21:28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
live.canon|genesis|21:31: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
live.canon|genesis|21:32: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
live.canon|genesis|21:33: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Yahuah (LORD), El Olam (the everlasting God).
live.canon|genesis|21:34: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.
live.canon|genesis|22:18: And in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because you have obeyed my voice.
live.canon|genesis|22:20: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she has also born children unto your brother Nahor;
live.canon|genesis|22:2: And he said, Take now your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and get you into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell you of.
live.canon|genesis|22:5: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide you here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
live.canon|genesis|22:12: And he said, Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you any thing unto him: for now I know that you fearest Elohim (God), seeing you have not withheld your son, your only son from me.
live.canon|genesis|22:16: And said, By myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (LORD), for because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son:
live.canon|genesis|22:17: That in blessing I will bless you, and in multiplying I will multiply your seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and your seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
live.canon|genesis|22:1: And it came to pass after these things, that Elohim (God) did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
live.canon|genesis|22:3: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which Elohim (God) had told him.
live.canon|genesis|22:4: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
live.canon|genesis|22:6: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
live.canon|genesis|22:7: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
live.canon|genesis|22:8: And Abraham said, My son, Elohim (God) will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
live.canon|genesis|22:9: And they came to the place which Elohim (God) had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
live.canon|genesis|22:10: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
live.canon|genesis|22:11: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
live.canon|genesis|22:13: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
live.canon|genesis|22:14: And Abraham called the name of that place Yahuah Yireh (Jehovah-jireh): as it is said to this day, In the mount of Yahuah (LORD) it shall be seen.
live.canon|genesis|22:15: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
live.canon|genesis|22:19: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
live.canon|genesis|22:21: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
live.canon|genesis|22:22: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
live.canon|genesis|22:23: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
live.canon|genesis|22:24: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
live.canon|genesis|23:6: Hear us, my lord: you are a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury your dead; none of us shall withhold from you his sepulchre, but that you may bury your dead.
live.canon|genesis|23:9: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
live.canon|genesis|23:11: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I you, and the cave that is therein, I give it you; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it you: bury your dead.
live.canon|genesis|23:13: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if you will give it, I pray you, hear me: I will give you money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
live.canon|genesis|23:15: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and you? bury therefore your dead.
live.canon|genesis|23:1: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
live.canon|genesis|23:2: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
live.canon|genesis|23:3: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
live.canon|genesis|23:4: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
live.canon|genesis|23:5: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
live.canon|genesis|23:7: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
live.canon|genesis|23:8: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
live.canon|genesis|23:10: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
live.canon|genesis|23:12: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
live.canon|genesis|23:14: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
live.canon|genesis|23:16: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
live.canon|genesis|23:17: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
live.canon|genesis|23:18: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
live.canon|genesis|23:19: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|23:20: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
live.canon|genesis|24:3: And I will make you swear by Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of heaven, and the Elohim (God) of the earth, that you shall not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
live.canon|genesis|24:5: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring your son again unto the land from whence you came?
live.canon|genesis|24:6: And Abraham said unto him, Beware you that you bring not my son thither again.
live.canon|genesis|24:7: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto your seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife unto my son from thence.
live.canon|genesis|24:8: And if the woman will not be willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
live.canon|genesis|24:12: And he said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of my master Abraham, I pray you, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
live.canon|genesis|24:14: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down your pitcher, I pray you, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give your camels drink also: let the same be she that you have appointed for your servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that you have shewed kindness unto my master.
live.canon|genesis|24:17: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray you, drink a little water of your pitcher.
live.canon|genesis|24:19: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for your camels also, until they have done drinking.
live.canon|genesis|24:23: And said, Whose daughter are you? tell me, I pray you: is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge in?
live.canon|genesis|24:27: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of my master Abraham, who has not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, Yahuah (LORD) led me to the house of my master’s brethren.
live.canon|genesis|24:31: And he said, Come in, you blessed of Yahuah (LORD); wherefore stand you without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
live.canon|genesis|24:33: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told my errand. And he said, Speak on.
live.canon|genesis|24:35: And Yahuah (LORD) has blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he has given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
live.canon|genesis|24:36: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him has he given all that he has.
live.canon|genesis|24:37: And my master made me swear, saying, You shall not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
live.canon|genesis|24:38: But you shall go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
live.canon|genesis|24:40: And he said unto me, Yahuah (LORD), before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:
live.canon|genesis|24:41: Then shall you be clear from this my oath, when you come to my kindred; and if they give not you one, you shall be clear from my oath.
live.canon|genesis|24:42: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go:
live.canon|genesis|24:47: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter are you? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
live.canon|genesis|24:49: And now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
live.canon|genesis|24:50: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceeds from Yahuah (LORD): we cannot speak unto you bad or good.
live.canon|genesis|24:51: Behold, Rebekah is before you, take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
live.canon|genesis|24:56: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing Yahuah (LORD) has prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
live.canon|genesis|24:58: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Will you go with this man? And she said, I will go.
live.canon|genesis|24:60: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, You are our sister, be you the mother of thousands of millions, and let your seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
live.canon|genesis|24:65: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walks in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
live.canon|genesis|24:1: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and Yahuah (LORD) had blessed Abraham in all things.
live.canon|genesis|24:9: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
live.canon|genesis|24:10: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
live.canon|genesis|24:11: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
live.canon|genesis|24:13: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
live.canon|genesis|24:15: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
live.canon|genesis|24:16: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
live.canon|genesis|24:18: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
live.canon|genesis|24:20: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
live.canon|genesis|24:21: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether Yahuah (LORD) had made his journey prosperous or not.
live.canon|genesis|24:22: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
live.canon|genesis|24:24: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
live.canon|genesis|24:25: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
live.canon|genesis|24:26: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|genesis|24:28: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.
live.canon|genesis|24:29: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
live.canon|genesis|24:30: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
live.canon|genesis|24:32: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.
live.canon|genesis|24:34: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.
live.canon|genesis|24:39: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
live.canon|genesis|24:2: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray you, your hand under my thigh:
live.canon|genesis|24:4: But you shall go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|24:48: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped Yahuah (LORD), and blessed Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.
live.canon|genesis|24:52: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped Yahuah (LORD), bowing himself to the earth.
live.canon|genesis|24:53: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
live.canon|genesis|24:54: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
live.canon|genesis|24:55: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
live.canon|genesis|24:57: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
live.canon|genesis|24:59: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.
live.canon|genesis|24:61: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
live.canon|genesis|24:62: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.
live.canon|genesis|24:63: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
live.canon|genesis|24:64: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
live.canon|genesis|24:66: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
live.canon|genesis|24:67: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
live.canon|genesis|24:43: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin comes forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray you, a little water of your pitcher to drink;
live.canon|genesis|24:44: And she say to me, Both drink you, and I will also draw for your camels: let the same be the woman whom Yahuah (LORD) has appointed out for my master’s son.
live.canon|genesis|24:45: And before I had done speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray you.
live.canon|genesis|24:46: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give your camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
live.canon|genesis|25:23: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto her, Two nations are in your womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from your bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
live.canon|genesis|25:30: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray you, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
live.canon|genesis|25:31: And Jacob said, Sell me this day your birthright.
live.canon|genesis|25:1: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
live.canon|genesis|25:2: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
live.canon|genesis|25:3: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
live.canon|genesis|25:4: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
live.canon|genesis|25:5: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|25:6: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
live.canon|genesis|25:7: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
live.canon|genesis|25:8: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
live.canon|genesis|25:9: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
live.canon|genesis|25:10: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
live.canon|genesis|25:11: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that Elohim (God) blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.
live.canon|genesis|25:12: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
live.canon|genesis|25:13: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
live.canon|genesis|25:14: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
live.canon|genesis|25:15: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
live.canon|genesis|25:16: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
live.canon|genesis|25:17: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
live.canon|genesis|25:19: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:
live.canon|genesis|25:20: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
live.canon|genesis|25:21: And Isaac intreated Yahuah (LORD) for his wife, because she was barren: and Yahuah (LORD) was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
live.canon|genesis|25:22: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|genesis|25:24: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
live.canon|genesis|25:25: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
live.canon|genesis|25:26: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
live.canon|genesis|25:27: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
live.canon|genesis|25:28: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|25:29: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
live.canon|genesis|25:32: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
live.canon|genesis|25:33: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|25:34: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
live.canon|genesis|25:18: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
live.canon|genesis|26:2: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell you of:
live.canon|genesis|26:3: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you; for unto you, and unto your seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham your father;
live.canon|genesis|26:4: And I will make your seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto your seed all these countries; and in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
live.canon|genesis|26:9: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is your wife: and how saidst you, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
live.canon|genesis|26:10: And Abimelech said, What is this you have done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with your wife, and you should have brought guiltiness upon us.
live.canon|genesis|26:11: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|genesis|26:16: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for you are much mightier than we.
live.canon|genesis|26:22: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now Yahuah (LORD) has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
live.canon|genesis|26:24: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham your father: fear not, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.
live.canon|genesis|26:28: And they said, We saw certainly that Yahuah (LORD) was with you: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and you, and let us make a covenant with you;
live.canon|genesis|26:29: That you will do us no hurt, as we have not touched you, and as we have done unto you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace: you are now the blessed of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|genesis|26:1: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
live.canon|genesis|26:5: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
live.canon|genesis|26:7: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
live.canon|genesis|26:8: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
live.canon|genesis|26:12: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and Yahuah (LORD) blessed him.
live.canon|genesis|26:13: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
live.canon|genesis|26:14: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
live.canon|genesis|26:15: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
live.canon|genesis|26:17: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
live.canon|genesis|26:18: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
live.canon|genesis|26:19: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
live.canon|genesis|26:20: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
live.canon|genesis|26:21: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
live.canon|genesis|26:23: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
live.canon|genesis|26:25: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Yahuah (LORD), and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.
live.canon|genesis|26:26: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
live.canon|genesis|26:30: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
live.canon|genesis|26:31: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
live.canon|genesis|26:32: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
live.canon|genesis|26:33: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.
live.canon|genesis|26:34: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
live.canon|genesis|26:35: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
live.canon|genesis|26:27: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come you to me, seeing you hate me, and have sent me away from you?
live.canon|genesis|27:3: Now therefore take, I pray you, your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
live.canon|genesis|27:4: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless you before I die.
live.canon|genesis|27:6: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard your father speak unto Esau your brother, saying,
live.canon|genesis|27:7: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahuah (LORD) before my death.
live.canon|genesis|27:8: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
live.canon|genesis|27:9: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for your father, such as he loves:
live.canon|genesis|27:10: And you shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, and that he may bless you before his death.
live.canon|genesis|27:13: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be your curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
live.canon|genesis|27:18: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who are you, my son?
live.canon|genesis|27:19: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau your firstborn; I have done according as you badest me: arise, I pray you, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.
live.canon|genesis|27:20: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought it to me.
live.canon|genesis|27:21: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray you, that I may feel you, my son, whether you be my very son Esau or not.
live.canon|genesis|27:24: And he said, Are you my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
live.canon|genesis|27:25: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
live.canon|genesis|27:27: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahuah (LORD) has blessed:
live.canon|genesis|27:28: Therefore Elohim (God) give you of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
live.canon|genesis|27:29: Let people serve you, and nations bow down to you: be lord over your brethren, and let your mother’s sons bow down to you: cursed be every one that curses you, and blessed be he that blesses you.
live.canon|genesis|27:31: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.
live.canon|genesis|27:33: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that has taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
live.canon|genesis|27:35: And he said, Your brother came with subtilty, and has taken away your blessing.
live.canon|genesis|27:36: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he has supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Have you not reserved a blessing for me?
live.canon|genesis|27:37: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto you, my son?
live.canon|genesis|27:38: And Esau said unto his father, Have you but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
live.canon|genesis|27:39: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, your dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
live.canon|genesis|27:40: And by your sword shall you live, and shall serve your brother; and it shall come to pass when you shall have the dominion, that you shall break his yoke from off your neck.
live.canon|genesis|27:42: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, your brother Esau, as touching you, does comfort himself, purposing to kill you.
live.canon|genesis|27:43: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee you to Laban my brother to Haran;
live.canon|genesis|27:44: And tarry with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turn away;
live.canon|genesis|27:45: Until your brother’s anger turn away from you, and he forget that which you have done to him: then I will send, and fetch you from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
live.canon|genesis|27:1: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
live.canon|genesis|27:2: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
live.canon|genesis|27:5: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
live.canon|genesis|27:11: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
live.canon|genesis|27:12: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
live.canon|genesis|27:14: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
live.canon|genesis|27:15: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
live.canon|genesis|27:16: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
live.canon|genesis|27:17: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|27:22: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
live.canon|genesis|27:23: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.
live.canon|genesis|27:26: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
live.canon|genesis|27:30: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
live.canon|genesis|27:34: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
live.canon|genesis|27:41: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|27:46: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
live.canon|genesis|27:32: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who are you? And he said, I am your son, your firstborn Esau.
live.canon|genesis|28:1: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|28:2: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father; and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
live.canon|genesis|28:3: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a multitude of people;
live.canon|genesis|28:4: And give you the blessing of Abraham, to you, and to your seed with you; that you may inherit the land wherein you are a stranger, which Elohim (God) gave unto Abraham.
live.canon|genesis|28:6: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
live.canon|genesis|28:13: And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac: the land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your seed;
live.canon|genesis|28:14: And your seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and you shall spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in you and in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
live.canon|genesis|28:15: And, behold, I am with you, and will keep you in all places whither you go, and will bring you again into this land; for I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken to you of.
live.canon|genesis|28:5: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
live.canon|genesis|28:7: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;
live.canon|genesis|28:8: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
live.canon|genesis|28:9: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
live.canon|genesis|28:10: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
live.canon|genesis|28:11: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
live.canon|genesis|28:12: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it.
live.canon|genesis|28:16: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely Yahuah (LORD) is in this place; and I knew it not.
live.canon|genesis|28:17: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven.
live.canon|genesis|28:18: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
live.canon|genesis|28:19: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
live.canon|genesis|28:20: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If Elohim (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
live.canon|genesis|28:21: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall Yahuah (LORD) be my Elohim (God):
live.canon|genesis|28:22: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be Elohim's (God’s) house: and of all that you shall give me I will surely give the tenth unto you.
live.canon|genesis|29:4: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be you? And they said, Of Haran are we.
live.canon|genesis|29:5: And he said unto them, Know you Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
live.canon|genesis|29:6: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter comes with the sheep.
live.canon|genesis|29:7: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water you the sheep, and go and feed them.
live.canon|genesis|29:14: And Laban said to him, Surely you are my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
live.canon|genesis|29:15: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because you are my brother, should you therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall your wages be?
live.canon|genesis|29:18: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter.
live.canon|genesis|29:19: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
live.canon|genesis|29:25: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this you have done unto me? did not I serve with you for Rachel? wherefore then have you beguiled me?
live.canon|genesis|29:27: Fulfil her week, and we will give you this also for the service which you shall serve with me yet seven other years.
live.canon|genesis|29:32: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely Yahuah (LORD) has looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
live.canon|genesis|29:33: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because Yahuah (LORD) has heard that I was hated, he has therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
live.canon|genesis|29:1: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
live.canon|genesis|29:2: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.
live.canon|genesis|29:3: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.
live.canon|genesis|29:8: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.
live.canon|genesis|29:9: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.
live.canon|genesis|29:10: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
live.canon|genesis|29:11: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
live.canon|genesis|29:12: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.
live.canon|genesis|29:13: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
live.canon|genesis|29:16: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
live.canon|genesis|29:17: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
live.canon|genesis|29:20: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
live.canon|genesis|29:21: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
live.canon|genesis|29:22: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
live.canon|genesis|29:23: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
live.canon|genesis|29:24: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
live.canon|genesis|29:26: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
live.canon|genesis|29:28: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
live.canon|genesis|29:29: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
live.canon|genesis|29:30: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
live.canon|genesis|29:31: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
live.canon|genesis|29:34: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
live.canon|genesis|29:35: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise Yahuah (LORD): therefore she called his name Yahudah (Judah); and left bearing.
live.canon|genesis|30:2: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in Elohim's (God’s) stead, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?
live.canon|genesis|30:6: And Rachel said, Elohim (God) has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
live.canon|genesis|30:11: And Leah said, A troop comes: and she called his name Gad.
live.canon|genesis|30:14: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray you, of your son’s mandrakes.
live.canon|genesis|30:15: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that you have taken my husband? and would you take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with you to night for your son’s mandrakes.
live.canon|genesis|30:16: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, You must come in unto me; for surely I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
live.canon|genesis|30:18: And Leah said, Elohim (God) has given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
live.canon|genesis|30:20: And Leah said, Elohim (God) has endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
live.canon|genesis|30:23: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, Elohim (God) has taken away my reproach:
live.canon|genesis|30:25: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto my own place, and to my country.
live.canon|genesis|30:26: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served you, and let me go: for you know my service which I have done you.
live.canon|genesis|30:27: And Laban said unto him, I pray you, if I have found favour in your eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that Yahuah (LORD) has blessed me for your sake.
live.canon|genesis|30:28: And he said, Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.
live.canon|genesis|30:29: And he said unto him, You know how I have served you, and how your cattle was with me.
live.canon|genesis|30:30: For it was little which you had before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and Yahuah (LORD) has blessed you since my coming: and now when shall I provide for my own house also?
live.canon|genesis|30:31: And he said, What shall I give you? And Jacob said, You shall not give me any thing: if you will do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep your flock:
live.canon|genesis|30:32: I will pass through all your flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
live.canon|genesis|30:33: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before your face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
live.canon|genesis|30:34: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to your word.
live.canon|genesis|30:1: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
live.canon|genesis|30:3: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
live.canon|genesis|30:4: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
live.canon|genesis|30:5: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
live.canon|genesis|30:7: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
live.canon|genesis|30:8: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
live.canon|genesis|30:9: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
live.canon|genesis|30:10: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.
live.canon|genesis|30:12: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.
live.canon|genesis|30:13: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
live.canon|genesis|30:17: And Elohim (God) hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
live.canon|genesis|30:19: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
live.canon|genesis|30:21: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
live.canon|genesis|30:22: And Elohim (God) remembered Rachel, and Elohim (God) hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
live.canon|genesis|30:24: And she called his name Joseph; and said, Yahuah (LORD) shall add to me another son.
live.canon|genesis|30:35: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
live.canon|genesis|30:36: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
live.canon|genesis|30:37: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
live.canon|genesis|30:38: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
live.canon|genesis|30:39: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
live.canon|genesis|30:40: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.
live.canon|genesis|30:41: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
live.canon|genesis|30:42: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
live.canon|genesis|30:43: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
live.canon|genesis|31:1: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s has he gotten all this glory.
live.canon|genesis|31:3: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of your fathers, and to your kindred; and I will be with you.
live.canon|genesis|31:5: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the Elohim (God) of my father has been with me.
live.canon|genesis|31:6: And you know that with all my power I have served your father.
live.canon|genesis|31:7: And your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but Elohim (God) suffered him not to hurt me.
live.canon|genesis|31:8: If he said thus, The speckled shall be your wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be your hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
live.canon|genesis|31:9: Thus Elohim (God) has taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
live.canon|genesis|31:10: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
live.canon|genesis|31:12: And he said, Lift up now your eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban does unto you.
live.canon|genesis|31:13: I am the Elohim (God) of Beth-el, where you anointedst the pillar, and where you vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get you out from this land, and return unto the land of your kindred.
live.canon|genesis|31:24: And Elohim (God) came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that you speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
live.canon|genesis|31:26: And Laban said to Jacob, What have you done, that you have stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
live.canon|genesis|31:27: Wherefore did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and did not tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
live.canon|genesis|31:28: And have not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? you have now done foolishly in so doing.
live.canon|genesis|31:29: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the Elohim (God) of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take you heed that you speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
live.canon|genesis|31:30: And now, though you would needs be gone, because you sore longedst after your father’s house, yet wherefore have you stolen my gods?
live.canon|genesis|31:31: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure you would take by force your daughters from me.
live.canon|genesis|31:32: With whomsoever you find your gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern you what is yours with me, and take it to you. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
live.canon|genesis|31:35: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before you; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
live.canon|genesis|31:36: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that you have so hotly pursued after me?
live.canon|genesis|31:37: Whereas you have searched all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? set it here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
live.canon|genesis|31:38: This twenty years have I been with you; your ewes and your she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of your flock have I not eaten.
live.canon|genesis|31:39: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto you; I bare the loss of it; of my hand did you require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
live.canon|genesis|31:40: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from my eyes.
live.canon|genesis|31:41: Thus have I been twenty years in your house; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your cattle: and you have changed my wages ten times.
live.canon|genesis|31:42: Except the Elohim (God) of my father, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely you had sent me away now empty. Elohim (God) has seen my affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked you yesternight.
live.canon|genesis|31:43: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that you see is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
live.canon|genesis|31:44: Now therefore come you, let us make a covenant, I and you; and let it be for a witness between me and you.
live.canon|genesis|31:48: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
live.canon|genesis|31:49: And Mizpah; for he said, Yahuah (LORD) watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
live.canon|genesis|31:50: If you shall afflict my daughters, or if you shall take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, Elohim (God) is witness betwixt me and you.
live.canon|genesis|31:51: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and you;
live.canon|genesis|31:52: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you shall not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
live.canon|genesis|31:2: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
live.canon|genesis|31:4: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
live.canon|genesis|31:11: And the angel of Elohim (God) spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
live.canon|genesis|31:14: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
live.canon|genesis|31:17: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
live.canon|genesis|31:18: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|31:19: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.
live.canon|genesis|31:20: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
live.canon|genesis|31:21: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
live.canon|genesis|31:22: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
live.canon|genesis|31:23: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
live.canon|genesis|31:25: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
live.canon|genesis|31:33: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
live.canon|genesis|31:34: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
live.canon|genesis|31:45: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
live.canon|genesis|31:46: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
live.canon|genesis|31:15: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he has sold us, and has quite devoured also our money.
live.canon|genesis|31:16: For all the riches which Elohim (God) has taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever Elohim (God) has said unto you, do.
live.canon|genesis|31:47: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
live.canon|genesis|31:53: The Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Nahor, the Elohim (God) of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|31:54: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
live.canon|genesis|31:55: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
live.canon|genesis|32:6: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to your brother Esau, and also he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.
live.canon|genesis|32:4: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you speak unto my lord Esau; Your servant Jacob says thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
live.canon|genesis|32:5: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in your sight.
live.canon|genesis|32:9: And Jacob said, O Elohim (God) of my father Abraham, and Elohim (God) of my father Isaac, Yahuah (LORD) which saidst unto me, Return unto your country, and to your kindred, and I will deal well with you:
live.canon|genesis|32:10: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which you have shewed unto your servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
live.canon|genesis|32:11: Deliver me, I pray you, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
live.canon|genesis|32:12: And you saidst, I will surely do you good, and make your seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
live.canon|genesis|32:17: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth you, and asks you, saying, Whose are you? and whither go you? and whose are these before you?
live.canon|genesis|32:18: Then you shall say, They be your servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
live.canon|genesis|32:19: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall you speak unto Esau, when you find him.
live.canon|genesis|32:20: And say you moreover, Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
live.canon|genesis|32:26: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaks. And he said, I will not let you go, except you bless me.
live.canon|genesis|32:27: And he said unto him, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|32:28: And he said, Your name shall be called no more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel): for as a prince have you power with Elohim (God) and with men, and have prevailed.
live.canon|genesis|32:29: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray you, your name. And he said, Wherefore is it that you do ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
live.canon|genesis|32:1: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of Elohim (God) met him.
live.canon|genesis|32:2: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is Elohim's (God’s) host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
live.canon|genesis|32:3: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
live.canon|genesis|32:7: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
live.canon|genesis|32:8: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
live.canon|genesis|32:13: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
live.canon|genesis|32:14: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
live.canon|genesis|32:15: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
live.canon|genesis|32:16: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
live.canon|genesis|32:21: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
live.canon|genesis|32:22: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
live.canon|genesis|32:23: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
live.canon|genesis|32:24: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
live.canon|genesis|32:25: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
live.canon|genesis|32:30: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen Elohim (God) face to face, and my life is preserved.
live.canon|genesis|32:31: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
live.canon|genesis|32:32: Therefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.
live.canon|genesis|33:5: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with you? And he said, The children which Elohim (God) has graciously given your servant.
live.canon|genesis|33:8: And he said, What meanest you by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
live.canon|genesis|33:9: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that you have unto thyself.
live.canon|genesis|33:10: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray you, if now I have found grace in your sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen your face, as though I had seen the face of Elohim (God), and you were pleased with me.
live.canon|genesis|33:11: Take, I pray you, my blessing that is brought to you; because Elohim (God) has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
live.canon|genesis|33:12: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.
live.canon|genesis|33:13: And he said unto him, My lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
live.canon|genesis|33:14: Let my lord, I pray you, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goes before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
live.canon|genesis|33:15: And Esau said, Let me now leave with you some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
live.canon|genesis|33:1: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
live.canon|genesis|33:2: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
live.canon|genesis|33:3: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
live.canon|genesis|33:4: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
live.canon|genesis|33:6: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
live.canon|genesis|33:7: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
live.canon|genesis|33:16: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
live.canon|genesis|33:17: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
live.canon|genesis|33:18: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.
live.canon|genesis|33:19: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.
live.canon|genesis|33:20: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|34:9: And make you marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
live.canon|genesis|34:10: And you shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade you therein, and get you possessions therein.
live.canon|genesis|34:11: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what you shall say unto me I will give.
live.canon|genesis|34:12: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as you shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
live.canon|genesis|34:15: But in this will we consent unto you: If you will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
live.canon|genesis|34:17: But if you will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
live.canon|genesis|34:30: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
live.canon|genesis|34:1: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
live.canon|genesis|34:2: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
live.canon|genesis|34:3: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
live.canon|genesis|34:4: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
live.canon|genesis|34:5: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
live.canon|genesis|34:6: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
live.canon|genesis|34:7: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
live.canon|genesis|34:8: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
live.canon|genesis|34:13: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
live.canon|genesis|34:14: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
live.canon|genesis|34:16: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
live.canon|genesis|34:18: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.
live.canon|genesis|34:19: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
live.canon|genesis|34:20: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
live.canon|genesis|34:21: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
live.canon|genesis|34:22: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
live.canon|genesis|34:23: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
live.canon|genesis|34:24: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
live.canon|genesis|34:25: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
live.canon|genesis|34:26: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.
live.canon|genesis|34:27: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
live.canon|genesis|34:28: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
live.canon|genesis|34:29: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
live.canon|genesis|34:31: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
live.canon|genesis|35:1: And Elohim (God) said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto Elohim (God), that appeared unto you when you fleddest from the face of Esau your brother.
live.canon|genesis|35:10: And Elohim (God) said unto him, Your name is Jacob: your name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall be your name: and he called his name Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|35:11: And Elohim (God) said unto him, I am El Shaddai (God Almighty): be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of you, and kings shall come out of your loins;
live.canon|genesis|35:12: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to you I will give it, and to your seed after you will I give the land.
live.canon|genesis|35:17: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; you shall have this son also.
live.canon|genesis|35:2: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
live.canon|genesis|35:3: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto Elohim (God), who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
live.canon|genesis|35:4: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
live.canon|genesis|35:5: And they journeyed: and the terror of Elohim (God) was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|35:6: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.
live.canon|genesis|35:7: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there Elohim (God) appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
live.canon|genesis|35:8: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.
live.canon|genesis|35:9: And Elohim (God) appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.
live.canon|genesis|35:13: And Elohim (God) went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
live.canon|genesis|35:14: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
live.canon|genesis|35:15: And Jacob called the name of the place where Elohim (God) spake with him, Beth-el.
live.canon|genesis|35:16: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
live.canon|genesis|35:18: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
live.canon|genesis|35:19: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.
live.canon|genesis|35:20: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
live.canon|genesis|35:21: And Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
live.canon|genesis|35:22: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Yashar'el (Israel) heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
live.canon|genesis|35:23: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah), and Issachar, and Zebulun:
live.canon|genesis|35:24: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
live.canon|genesis|35:25: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
live.canon|genesis|35:26: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.
live.canon|genesis|35:27: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
live.canon|genesis|35:28: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
live.canon|genesis|35:29: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
live.canon|genesis|36:1: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
